_comment: Named spells: a short name cached to a full chant (SEED or LENS words), so an agent never
has to re-derive a common summon. Append-only: a name, once minted, never changes meaning —
a correction is a NEW name, never an edit to this one. `dogg.py spell <name>` prints the words;
`--add` refuses an existing name or words that fail to check (chant_unpack must succeed).
wear/recite/attest accept a spell NAME anywhere words are expected (see as_words in dogg.py).

btc-alarm-70k.meaning: fires when BTC spot crosses above 70000 USD

eth-alarm-3k.meaning: fires when ETH spot crosses above 3000 USD

sunrise-atlanta.meaning: reads sunrise, sunset and day length for Atlanta

moon-watch.meaning: reads the current moon illumination percent

flood-watch.meaning: fires when the gauge crosses 90% of flood stage

gauge-select.meaning: reads the raw gauge height and its flood stage threshold
